about: S4.5 panel benchmark — the TUNING set. Fictional matters only. stop: whether a careful panel must stop for facts the documents do not give. H1-H3 were the first held-out set (run once on panel-s4.5b: stop 2/3); H1 showed the panel not stopping when all four perspectives lacked facts, fixed in s4.5c, so they became tuning data.

scenarios.question: What restrictions apply to the Executive after the employment ends under this Agreement?

documents.name: Service Agreement (fictional).txt
documents.text:
SERVICE AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is made between Corran Foods Ltd (the Company) and Imogen Hale (the Executive).

15. Restrictions after employment
15.1 For twelve (12) months after the employment ends, the Executive shall not work for a competitor of the Company in the United Kingdom.
15.2 For six (6) months after the employment ends, the Executive shall not solicit any customer of the Company with whom the Executive dealt in the last year of employment.
15.3 Each restriction is a separate covenant and is reduced by any time the Executive spends on garden leave.

scenarios.question: Must the Processor tell the Controller about a personal data breach, and how quickly?

documents.name: Data Processing Agreement (fictional).txt
documents.text:
DATA PROCESSING AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is made between Corran Foods Ltd (the Controller) and Northbridge Analytics AB (the Processor).

7. Personal data breaches
7.1 The Processor shall notify the Controller without undue delay, and in any event within twenty-four (24) hours, after becoming aware of a personal data breach.
7.2 The notice shall describe the nature of the breach and the measures taken.

11. Sub-processors
11.1 The Processor shall not engage a sub-processor without the Controller's prior written consent.
